name: Evolutionary Volumetric Data Structure (EVDS) / L-Block Compression (LBC)
definition: A compression and segmentation method for volumetric data using L-blocks (LBs) and L-block coverings (LBCs). It retains only significant data (polymerization) while treating remaining vertices as 'white space' to be ignored, allowing for real-time incremental generation and compression.
summary: EVDS/LBC is a hierarchical sparse structure for real-time incremental compression of volumetric data that packages significant voxels into connected L-blocks while ignoring empty space, avoiding parent traversal unlike standard AABB-trees.
